why: The student treats the indented println("done") as part of the if body. In Java a braceless if controls only the next statement, so java Order 3 prints "start" and then "done"; the answer also never addresses java Order five, which throws a NumberFormatException before anything is printed.

concepts.quote: Only start, because done is inside the if and 3 is not > 5
concepts.why: The student uses indentation to decide what is in the if body, but without braces the body is only the first statement (println("big")), so "done" always prints.
The answer makes no claim about main as the entry point, its statement order or its args parameter, and it says nothing about parseInt failing on "five".
